utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, thanks. Let’s keep it simple—just let me know if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and keep it simple if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in for the repair drive—just point me to what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—could you start by checking the porch light and that loose gate latch?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll check the porch light and gate latch now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are settled first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s still on, just waiting on the timing and drop-off details?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just remind me what I was supposed to bring again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — could you bring a roll of duct tape and a box of screws?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah yes — duct tape and a box of screws. I’ll bring both over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t heard the details yet — what exactly needs repairing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s the broken fence and a couple of loose steps, maybe the porch light too. I’m sorry, I missed the full list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll double-check the full list before we start. Broken fence, loose steps, and maybe the porch light, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss the part where we’re deciding who’s bringing tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not at all — we’re just sorting it out now. If you’ve got any tools you can bring, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring my toolbox and a couple of screwdrivers. If you need anything bigger, I can check the shed too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your drill and maybe a couple screwdrivers? I’ll handle the rest and we can get started at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Gus — I’ll bring my drill and a couple screwdrivers. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — thanks for the update. I’ll keep an eye out and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate that. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Faye — just let me know if you need me to check on anything nearby.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming along nicely—there’s already a good little pile of donations. If you’ve got anything to add, this seems like the perfect time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll swing by with a few things today and tell a couple neighbors too. The more we gather now, the better!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful, Quinn—thank you! I’ll keep spreading the word so we can make it a really solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Rey?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going steadily. I’ve mostly been listening and helping where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Glad to hear it—do you need any help with the next part?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive, and I’ll repeat the plan to anyone who asks. If you want, I can help remind folks too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still hearing things second-hand, so a reminder would really help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — the repair drive is coming up soon, and I’ll keep repeating the details so folks know where to go and when. If you hear anyone unsure, send them my way and I’ll remind them too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone updated. Let’s make a clear list of what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’d appreciate that — I can help with the list if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be great, Uli — let’s start with the biggest issues and I’ll jot them down. We can compare notes and see who can help with each one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you need anything fixed, now’s a good time to ask around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. I’ll make a quick list of what needs fixing and bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Eli—bring it by whenever you’re ready, and I’ll help spread the word if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — did I miss much about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, you didn’t miss much yet — I was just getting ready to repeat the plan. We’re still on for the repair drive, and I’ll fill you in right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — give me the quick version and I’ll catch up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out. What do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I just need help getting the tools and a little extra hands-on time when the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that. Just let me know when and where to bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’m in, just keep me posted on the time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as I have the time and a quick list of what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll watch for your update.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs sorting?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. I’m just checking the list first so I don’t miss anything—could you remind me what’s already covered and what still needs sorting?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I know the basics are being handled, but I’m not fully up to date on the list yet. If you share what’s already covered, I can help spot what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I might've missed the latest update, but I can check on it if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — that’d be great. Could you check the latest update and let me know what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll take a look now and come back with what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re still on track—folks are coming by this afternoon, and I’ve got a few tools ready if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—glad it’s still moving along. I’ll check back later and see if anyone needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Can you help me sort the donated tools and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help sort the donated tools and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the timing and where the drop-off is first. I’m a bit worried about coordinating the repair drive without mixing anything up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fair question — I’ll confirm the timing and drop-off spot, then I’ll let you know so we keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — please send me the timing and drop-off spot as soon as you have them. I want to make sure I can plan around it and not miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m already telling folks to swing by — want me to spread the word about the time and place?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please—tell everyone it’s at the community shed this Saturday at 10 a.m. I’ll bring the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread it around right away: community shed this Saturday at 10 a.m. Folks can bring their tools and good energy!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around school pickup and drop-off. What time does the repair drive need us there?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m not sure I’ve got the exact time handy. I’ll check and get back to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that works for me — just let me know when you find out and I’ll plan around school.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m getting the repair drive organized and keeping a tidy list of who needs what. If you’ve heard of any neighbors who could use a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear of anyone who needs help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate that. If anyone comes to mind, just point them my way and I’ll take it from there.
